title: Continuous FP8 Calibration Service for Hopper: model-aware selector and drift remediation
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Build a continuous calibration service that automatically evaluates, scores, and selects FP8 profiles (E4M3/E5M2 variants) for Hopper deployments. The service runs shadow/bench workloads, computes a per-model Statistical Calibration Score (SCS), detects drift vs. golden baselines, and triggers staged rollouts or automated fallback to safer profiles when thresholds are exceeded. This ticket covers design, implementation, CI/validation, telemetry schema, and the operational runbook for safety and rollbacks.
tasks: Design SCS metric: composite of token-level KL, top-k token overlap, and normalized generation delta across sequence-length bins
Implement shadow-run harness that replays production prefixes to Hopper FP8 candidates without affecting live traffic
Add per-shard, per-model sequence-length binning to ensure calibration covers short/mid/long paths
Create a profile preference vector for each model that ranks E4M3/E5M2/int8 variants by SCS and latency cost
Integrate calibration service with routing: propose profile selector API + feature flag gate for canary rollouts
Instrumentation: emit quant_profile_choice, scs_score, scs_components, drift_alert, and fallback_reason events to telemetry
CI: add golden-suite tests (anchor-100 prompt set) and automated SCS regression checks to PR pipeline
Build automated rollback flow in orchestrator: on sustained drift_alerts trigger graceful demotion to last-known-good profile
Author runbook and on-call play for drift incidents including triage checklist and data collection steps
End-to-end performance validation: measure tail latency, p50/p95 token cost delta vs baseline and confirm SLA safety
acceptance_criteria: Calibration service produces SCS for every candidate profile within 5 minutes of a shadow-run completion
SCS and component metrics are visible in the Console per-model page and per-rollout
Automated canary plan: 1% -> 5% -> 20% traffic promotion runs without SCS regressions for at least 24h at each step
If SCS falls below configured threshold for 60 minutes, orchestrator triggers fallback and creates an incident with collected artifacts
CI golden-suite prevents merging any change that increases SCS delta beyond guardrail for supported models
Telemetry schema approved and emitted for every calibration run (stored for 90 days by default)

decisions: Use a composite SCS instead of single-metric pass/fail to reduce false positives in heterogeneous workloads
Prefer token-level KL (with per-bin normalization) as the primary SCS component; include top-k overlap and length-weighted delta as secondary signals
Run calibration shadow workloads with KV cache warmstart to match production memory state
Default canary promotion schedule will be 1%/5%/20% unless the model owner requests a different cadence
Automated rollback will be conservative: demote to the most recent profile with SCS above threshold and rerun golden-suite before re-promotion
risk_and_mitigation: Risk: false positives from noisy SCS signals could unnecessarily demote performant profiles and cause latency regression. Mitigation: multi-signal SCS, hysteresis windows (60m), minimum traffic thresholds, and human-in-loop review for high-impact models. Risk: telemetry volume increase — mitigate with sampling and compressed payloads. Risk: calibration shadow runs may add load to Dedicated pools — schedule during controlled windows and limit concurrency.
observability_requirements: Expose per-profile scs_score, scs_components, sample_count, latency_p50, latency_p95, cost_per_token_estimate, fallback_count. Dashboards for historical SCS trends and alert when SCS delta > configured guardrail for 30m.
test_plan: 1) Unit tests for SCS computation math. 2) Integration tests: shadow harness against synthetic prefixes with known deltas. 3) Golden-suite regression: anchor-100 must not regress beyond epsilon on merge. 4) Load test: ensure calibration jobs do not affect p95 latency for production lane under 5% traffic injection.
operational_runbook: Steps: 1) On drift_alert, collect last 6 hours of scs_components and sample generations. 2) Run golden-suite locally and compare. 3) If automated rollback executed, verify traffic demotion and re-run smoke eval. 4) Escalate to ML Infra and Product owner if human review required.
notes: This ticket intentionally focuses on the service and safety surface; separate tickets will cover UX in Console (per-model SCS visualization) and long-term storage/aggregation retention changes.
